title: Language Prior Is Not the Only Shortcut: A Benchmark for Shortcut Learning in VQA

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model performance on out-of-distribution (OOD) test sets where the answer distributions for specific language concepts (e.g., question types, keywords, keyword pairs) are shifted compared to the training set.
Evaluating model performance on OOD test sets where the answer distributions for specific visual concepts (e.g., key objects, key object pairs) are shifted compared to the training set.

Evaluating model performance on OOD test sets where the answer distributions for combinations of language and visual concepts (e.g., question type combined with a key object) are shifted compared to the training set.
